meta.title: 수능·내신 빈출 1,200 단어장 전체
meta.source: 2018~2025 수능·모의평가 8개년 + 고교 내신 300지문 교차분석 (교육부 2015 개정 교육과정 2,500 기준)

words.caution: deteriorate vs determine (결정하다) — dete- 5글자 동일, 끝 -riorate/-ermine 구분
words.example: Air pollution can deteriorate children’s lung function even at low levels.
words.cloze: The service deteriorated after the budget cuts.

words.example: Time constraints often force us to make intuitive decisions.
words.cloze: Budget constraints limited the project scope.

words.caution: perspective vs prospective(장래의) — e/o 한 글자 차이
words.example: From an ecological perspective, the forest is a system.
words.example_ko: 우리는 그 문제에 더 넓은 관점이 필요하다.
words.cloze: We need a broader perspective on the issue.

words.example: The prevalent belief that talent is innate discourages effort.
words.example_ko: 비만은 도시에서 더 널리 퍼져 있다.
words.cloze: Obesity is more prevalent in urban areas.

words.caution: sustainable = 환경·경제가 스스로 유지 가능한 (단순 ‘가능한’ 아님)
words.example: Renewable energy is key to sustaining growth without harming the planet.
words.example_ko: 그 도시는 인구를 부양할 수 있을까?
words.cloze: Can the city sustain its population?

words.caution: im(안) vs ex(밖) — 접힌 vs 펼친
words.example: The ad carries an implicit message: happiness can be bought.

words.caution: be biased against/toward — against(반대편향) vs toward(우호)
words.example: Confirmation bias makes us notice only supporting evidence.
words.cloze: The study was free from bias.

words.caution: acquire(습득) vs enquire(문의) — a/e 첫 모음 구분
words.example: Children acquire language through constant interaction.
words.example_ko: 아이들은 끊임없는 상호작용을 통해 언어를 습득한다.

words.caution: adapt(적응) vs adopt(입양/채택) — 두 번째 자음 p/t 구분
words.example: Plants adapt to arid conditions by storing water.
words.example_ko: 식물은 물을 저장하며 건조한 환경에 적응한다.
words.cloze: Plants ______ to arid conditions by storing water.

words.caution: adequate(충분) vs adequate to/for 구별 — adequate for 목적
words.example: The evidence is adequate to support the conclusion.
words.cloze: The evidence is ______ to support the conclusion.

words.example: The hotel is adjacent to the museum.
words.cloze: The hotel is ______ to the museum.

words.caution: adjust to N / adjust N to N — to 구문 주의
words.example: You need to adjust the lens to get a clear image.
words.example_ko: 선명한 이미지를 얻으려면 렌즈를 조정해야 한다.
words.cloze: You need to ______ the lens to get a clear image.

words.caution: advocate+v. /ˈædvəkeɪt/ vs n. /ˈædvəkət/ — 강세로 품사 구분
words.example: She advocates renewable energy in her community.
words.cloze: She ______ renewable energy in her community.

words.caution: affect(동사, 영향) vs effect(명사, 결과) — 어휘 빈출 함정 1위
words.example: Sleep deprivation can affect academic performance.
words.example_ko: 수면 부족은 학업 성취에 영향을 미칠 수 있다.

words.example: The clinic is affiliated with the university hospital.
words.cloze: The clinic is ______ with the university hospital.

words.caution: can afford to V / can afford N — to부정사/명사 모두 가능
words.example: We cannot afford to ignore climate change any longer.
words.example_ko: 우리는 기후 변화를 더 이상 무시할 여유가 없다.
words.cloze: We cannot ______ to ignore climate change any longer.

words.caution: aggregate n. /ˈæɡrɪɡət/ vs v. /ˈæɡrɪɡeɪt/ — 품사에 따라 발음
words.example: The aggregate score determines the final ranking.
words.cloze: The ______ score determines the final ranking.

words.caution: albeit + 형용사/부사 — albeit difficult, albeit slowly (절 아님)
words.example: The task was completed, albeit late.

words.caution: alleviate(완화) vs elevate(높이다) — 첫 모음 a/e 구분
words.example: Meditation can alleviate anxiety before exams.
words.example_ko: 명상은 시험 전 불안을 완화할 수 있다.

words.caution: allocate A to B / allocate A for B — 전치사 to/for
words.example: The budget will allocate funds to public education.
words.cloze: The budget will ______ funds to public education.
